questions.question: Explain the mission of St. Thomas in India based on Act of Thomas.
questions.solution_html:
• Act of Thomas: A Syriac text written on 3rd century at Edessa- This text describe the
  • Apostle’s mission in India and narrative is set out 13 sections called acts- The work provides
  • dramatic narratives of Thomas miraculous evangelistic adventures in India- Two poems
  • incorporated with this text: Hymn of Bride and Hymn of Pearl.
questions.final_answer: incorporated with this text: Hymn of Bride and Hymn of Pearl

questions.question: Discuss the features of Aphrahat Demonstrations.
questions.solution_html:
• Demonstrations is used to indicate the works of Aphrahat. it means appearance, showing
  • forth or manifestation. The Demonstations is collection of 23 sermons. Demonstrations written in
  • elegant classical Syriac. 22 demonstrations written according to the 22 letters of alphabets of
  • Syriac. 23rd demonstrations begins again with the first letter of Syriac alphabet demonstrations
  • deals with the basic aspects of Christian life
questions.final_answer: deals with the basic aspects of Christian life
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: What message does the parable of Prodigal son convey about repentance and forgiveness?
questions.solution_html:
• Prodigal son;
  • The parable of the Prodigal Son conveys powerful messages about repentance and
  • forgiveness. Repentance; God welcomes back those who return: The father accepts his
  • son despite his mistakes, showing God's willingness to forgive and restore.
  • True repentance involves humility: The prodigal son acknowledges his wrongdoing and
  • humbly returns to his father. Forgiveness; Unconditional forgiveness: The father's
  • forgiveness is immediate and complete, reflecting God's boundless mercy.
  • Restoration: The son is restored to his former position, symbolizing God's desire to
  • restore relationships.The parable highlights God's love, mercy, and forgiveness
  • encouraging us to approach Him with humility and trust.
questions.final_answer: encouraging us to approach Him with humility and trust
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: What does the parable Good Samaritan revels about Gods expectations for humanity?
questions.solution_html:
• Parable of Good Samaritan;
  • The Parable of the Good Samaritan (Luke 10:25-37) reveals God's expectations for
  • humanity:Love and serve others selflessly,Show compassion to those in need,Treat others with
  • kindness, regardless of differences him
